nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable holding the mint price (0.01 ether) read by claim() and compared against msg.value.
Ownable private address state variable storing the contract owner; written by _setOwner and read by onlyOwner/owner().
ReentrancyGuard private uint256 status flag used by the nonReentrant modifier on claim() and ownerClaim().
ERC721 mapping(uint256=>address) token id to owner, written by _mint/_transfer/_burn and read by ownerOf/_exists.
ERC721 mapping(address=>uint256) owner balances, incremented/decremented in _mint/_transfer/_burn (arithmetic).
ERC721Enumerable uint256[] array of all token ids, mutated by _beforeTokenTransfer enumeration helpers.
Public payable nonReentrant mint entry point: checks flootPrice <= msg.value and tokenId range 1..7777, then _safeMint(_msgSender(), tokenId).
Public nonReentrant onlyOwner mint entry point allowing the owner to mint tokenIds 7778..8000 to owner().
Public view override that builds the on-chain SVG/JSON metadata, using tokenId arithmetic and calling toString.
FLoot internal pure helper converting a uint256 to its decimal string using digit increments, value % 10 and 48 + ... (arithmetic).
ERC721 internal safe mint: calls _mint then _checkOnERC721Received, which performs an external callback to the receiver.
ERC721 internal mint: updates _balances and _owners and emits Transfer for a new tokenId.
ERC721Enumerable hook invoked before every mint/transfer/burn that maintains _ownedTokens and _allTokens enumeration state.
Private function that performs a low-level external call to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received, transferring control to an untrusted recipient contract.
ERC721 internal transfer: validates ownership, clears approvals and updates _balances/_owners with arithmetic and state writes.
ERC721 internal approval setter writing _tokenApprovals and emitting Approval.
Context internal view returning msg.sender; the source of caller identity used by claim and onlyOwner.
Ownable public onlyOwner function that validates the new owner and forwards to _setOwner.
Ownable private function that writes the _owner state variable and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Access-control modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(); gates ownerClaim, transferOwnership and renounceOwnership.
Untrusted caller identity; used as mint recipient in claim via _msgSender() and in access-control comparisons.
Untrusted external call to the recipient contract via onERC721Received inside _checkOnERC721Received, enabling reentrancy into minting logic.
Arithmetic operations in toString/tokenURI (digits++, digits -= 1, 48 + value % 10, value /= 10) performed on user-controlled tokenId.
Token supply/balance arithmetic (_balances[to] += 1, _balances[from] -= 1) in _mint and _transfer that can underflow/overflow accounting.
uint256 tokenId argument of claim(), validated against range and forwarded to _safeMint.
uint256 tokenId argument of ownerClaim(), validated against the owner range and forwarded to _safeMint.
uint256 tokenId argument of tokenURI(), used in modulo arithmetic and forwarded to toString.
uint256 value argument of the internal toString helper that is divided and moduloed during conversion.
Local string in tokenURI assigned 'big'/'medium'/'small' based on tokenId%3 and embedded in the SVG output.
Local string in tokenURI holding the concatenated SVG and final base64 data URI returned to the caller.
address to argument of _mint, checked against address(0) and used as the balance/ownership recipient.
uint256 tokenId argument of _mint, checked with _exists and written into _owners.
address from argument of _transfer, must match ownerOf(tokenId) and whose balance is decremented.
address to argument of _transfer, must be non-zero and receives ownership and balance increment.
uint256 tokenId argument of _transfer used for ownership lookup and approval clearing.
address newOwner argument of transferOwnership, validated as non-zero before being passed to _setOwner.
Local uint256 temp copy of value inside toString used for the digit-counting loop.
Local uint256 digits counter in toString incremented and decremented during buffer filling.
Local bytes buffer in toString written index-by-index before being cast to string.

edges.reason: The tokenId parameter is bound into claim() and used in its range require and mint call.
The tokenId parameter is bound into ownerClaim() and used in its range require and mint call.
The tokenId parameter is bound into tokenURI() and drives metadata generation.
The value parameter is bound into the FLoot toString helper and converted to decimal.
claim() calls _safeMint after its price and range checks.
ownerClaim() calls _safeMint after its range check and onlyOwner gate.
claim's user-supplied tokenId flows directly into _safeMint as the token id.
msg.sender (via _msgSender()) is passed as the recipient of _safeMint in claim().
msg.sender is the caller and the derived NFT owner in claim().
_safeMint first performs the raw mint through _mint.
_safeMint subsequently calls _checkOnERC721Received, which hands control to the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external callback to an untrusted recipient contract.
The external recipient callback can re-enter the public claim() mint entry point.
_mint writes the new owner into the _owners mapping.
_mint increments _balances[to] by 1, an arithmetic accounting update.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating state.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating state.
_transfer reassigns ownership in _owners[tokenId].
_transfer decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance.
_transfer clears the previous approval by calling _approve(address(0), tokenId).
toString performs digit, modulus and addition arithmetic on the value derived from tokenId.
_transfer contains unchecked-style balance subtraction/addition operations.
_mint contains balance addition operations tracked as arithmetic.
The temp local is divided inside the digit-counting arithmetic in toString.
The digits counter is incremented and decremented during the arithmetic conversion.
The buffer local is indexed using digits-derived arithmetic in toString.
claim() reads the flootPrice state variable for its payment requirement.
ownerClaim() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier, restricting privileged minting.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable through owner().
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender() for authorization.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transferOwnership forwards the validated new owner to _setOwner under onlyOwner.
The newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership's validation and delegation.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
The nonReentrant modifier on claim reads and writes the _status guard variable.
The nonReentrant modifier on ownerClaim reads and writes the _status guard variable.
The enumeration hook indirectly maintains ownership-consistent token bookkeeping tied to _owners.
The enumeration hook relies on _balances to index owner token lists.
The enumeration hook pushes/pops token ids in the _allTokens array.
tokenURI() calls the FLoot toString helper to render the token id.
tokenURI() reads _owners via the _exists check for the requested token.
tokenURI forwards its user-controlled tokenId into toString for decimal conversion.
The size local computed from tokenId%3 is embedded into the tokenURI output.
The output local carries the final base64 data URI returned by tokenURI.
The to parameter of _mint is used as the recipient for balance and ownership updates.
The tokenId parameter of _mint is checked and written into _owners.
The from parameter of _transfer drives the ownership require and balance decrement.
The to parameter of _transfer is validated and receives the token and balance.
The tokenId parameter of _transfer is used for ownerOf and approval clearing.
The from address is validated against _owners[tokenId] ownership.
The to address becomes the new entry in the _owners mapping.
The to address indexes the _balances increment arithmetic.
The from address indexes the _balances decrement arithmetic.
The mint recipient indexes the _balances[to] += 1 arithmetic.
The mint recipient is stored as the owner of the new token id.
The tokenId is passed to _approve(address(0), tokenId) to clear approvals.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenId parameter has no meaning outside claim() and should be folded into its entry-point function node.
The tokenId parameter is local to ownerClaim() and should be merged into that core function node.
The tokenId parameter only exists within tokenURI() and should collapse into the tokenURI function node.
The value parameter belongs solely to the internal toString helper and merges into it.
The size local is a temporary within tokenURI and should be absorbed by that function node.
The output local is the return scratch value of tokenURI and merges into the tokenURI node.
The to parameter is scoped to _mint and should be folded into the _mint function node.
The tokenId parameter is scoped to _mint and merges into the _mint function node.
The from parameter is scoped to _transfer and merges into the _transfer function node.
The to parameter is scoped to _transfer and merges into the _transfer function node.
The tokenId parameter is scoped to _transfer and merges into the _transfer function node.
The newOwner parameter is scoped to transferOwnership and merges into that function node.
The temp local only carries values through the arithmetic conversion and merges into the arithmetic unsafe_operation.
The digits counter is intrinsic to the arithmetic conversion and merges into the arithmetic unsafe_operation.
The buffer local is written using digits-derived arithmetic and merges into the arithmetic unsafe_operation.
